# Localization source audit allowlist
#
# Format:
#   glob :: reason
#
# Every entry must include a human-readable reason. Keep this file small and
# remove or narrow entries as each localization bundle is completed. The source
# audit fails if a matching entry is missing a reason.

app/api/** :: API route files are server endpoints, not rendered page/loading/error shells, and will be handled in the server-copy phase.
app/account/** :: Account route shells have focused localization guards, but the generic source audit still flags typed expressions; replace with per-file exceptions after the audit parser is refined.
app/cart/** :: Cart and checkout route shells have focused localization guards, but the generic source audit still flags typed expressions; replace with per-file exceptions after the audit parser is refined.
app/categories/** :: Category route shells have focused localization guards, but the generic source audit still flags typed expressions; replace with per-file exceptions after the audit parser is refined.
app/orders/** :: Public and account order route shells have focused localization guards, but the generic source audit still flags typed expressions; replace with per-file exceptions after the audit parser is refined.
app/products/** :: Product route shells have focused localization guards, but the generic source audit still flags typed expressions; replace with per-file exceptions after the audit parser is refined.
app/page.tsx :: Homepage route shell has a focused localization guard, but the generic source audit still flags brand/code expressions; remove after the audit parser is refined.
components/admin/** :: Phase 3 and Phase 4 admin extraction/localization are still in progress; replace with per-component entries as modules are completed.
components/storefront/** :: Phase 5 storefront localization is still in progress; replace with per-component entries as storefront surfaces are completed.
